summary: Staff-level engineer with nearly 20 years of building products and the platforms behind them, from data models and Node.js services to CLIs, CI/CD and the web front end. At Netflix I built the CLI tooling that moves 900+ JavaScript applications across breaking changes, built Data Mechanic, a greenfield data-quality application on a graph database, shared on-call for the platforms that build, deploy and run those applications, and led two JS Platform teams serving 1,000+ engineers through the shift to agentic development. At Walmart I was technical lead for a 50-engineer org and designed the server-rendered React architecture behind SamsClub.com, which drives millions of dollars in daily revenue.

roles.title: Engineering Manager, JS Platform
roles.homeSummary: Led two JS Platform teams in succession while staying close to the code: CI/CD, agent tooling, Jetpack and NodeQuark on-call.
roles.intro: Led two teams in succession in the JS Platform org, serving 1,000+ engineers across 900+ applications, including the owners of Jetpack (Netflix's platform for developing and deploying JavaScript apps) and NodeQuark (its managed Node.js runtime).
bullets: Championed and scoped a CI/CD overhaul for Netflix's busiest monorepo (~1,300 PRs merged per month), targeting a more than 50% cut in build cost and volume through package restructuring, work-avoidance patterns and a remote module cache; engineers were implementing it when I left.

Led the platform's shift to agentic development, with my teams shipping tooling to all 1,000+ engineers: headless remote dev servers for parallel agents, platform CLIs reworked so prompts became flags agents and scripts can run unattended, and llm-context in 100% of platform libraries, kept current by a CI-triggered agent.
Set long-term direction with the Jetpack Northstar foundation (guiding principles, strategy bets), aligning three platform teams and partners in Delivery, Source Control and Tech Catalog.
Created and led the Generative UI Working Group, evaluating MCP Apps, WebMCP and CopilotKit for agent-driven internal UIs.
Grew engineers, including converting an intern to full-time and preparing two engineers for promotion, and led a team through a reorg with no disruption to in-flight projects or growth plans.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, JS Platform
roles.homeSummary: Codemod upgrade CLI, library publishing paved path, GraphQL codegen, customer program with the top CSAT of any Netflix platform team.
bullets: Built an automated dependency-upgrade CLI with deterministic codemods (TS, CSS, GraphQL) that migrated the JS application fleet across breaking changes in the design system, browser runtime libraries and schema deprecations, cutting large-app migrations from weeks to days and saving thousands of engineering hours.
Shared on-call for Jetpack and NodeQuark, responding to production incidents on the platforms that build, deploy and run Netflix's JavaScript applications.
Designed and shipped Netflix's paved path for JavaScript library versioning and publishing, closing a years-long gap in the platform.
Built GraphQL introspection and codegen tooling with end-to-end type-safe requests across Netflix's federated graph, standardizing data fetching for JS clients.

Created and led a monthly customer program with product engineering teams, turning their feedback into roadmap features and earning the highest customer satisfaction scores of any platform team at Netflix.
Core maintainer of Hawkins Professional, Netflix's internal design system.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Studio Foundations
roles.homeSummary: Built Data Mechanic, a full-stack data-quality app on a graph database.
bullets: Built Data Mechanic, a greenfield full-stack data-quality application using algorithmic record matching and a graph database, making Data Admins an order of magnitude more efficient at deduplicating Netflix's talent, vendor and production records.
Designed a novel interface that shows how similar records connect in the graph, so users could see why records matched and resolve duplicates in one place.
